EXECUTIVE ORDER 11741
T h e 200th anniversary o f the birth o f the U nited States o f A m erica 
should be an occasion  fo r a nationw ide com m em oration w hich includes

Sec. 2. T h e official sym bol m ay be used either iii on e color or in  the
